description: This file defines the 'CKEDITOR.dataProcessor' class, serving as a base interface for data processor implementations within the CKEditor framework. It provides method signatures for transforming input data to HTML and converting HTML back to the editor's data format, along with documentation that explains their roles. It does not contain actual implementations or class instantiations.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dataProcessor
classes.description: A base class that defines the interface for data processors responsible for transforming editor data to and from HTML format.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.dataProcessor.prototype.toHtml
methods.description: Transforms input data into HTML to be loaded in the editor. Handles conversion from formats like BBCode to HTML.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.dataProcessor.prototype.toDataFormat
methods.description: Converts HTML from the editor into a specific data format like BBCode or plain text.
